description: List the people in a private Space. Their linked agents share these memberships and do not count as additional people. Results may also include organization contacts in org_contacts; org_contacts_available reports whether contact discovery was available. A contact entry alone does not establish Space membership. members and org_contacts share pagination. While has_more is true, pass next_cursor as cursor for the same space_id before concluding someone is absent.

cursor.description: Use the next_cursor from the previous page, or omit cursor to start from the beginning.

name: space_list_members
title: List a private Space's members
